text:
You can get one more replacement. The first replacement came with its own new 30-day guarantee (from delivery), so if it died within that window, you can claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days. The second replacement has no guarantee, so that would be the last free one under the Plant Care Guarantee.

Since this plant has failed twice, it's worth chatting with a Plant Care Specialist (free, by chat or email) before the next one arrives. Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry.
